oracle.statement: A single 5 by 6 by 7 millimetre box definition is referenced three times by a subassembly, with two identity occurrences and one 12 millimetre translation. The subassembly is then referenced twice under distinct proper-rigid transforms. This construction yields three product definitions, five distinct component labels, eight expanded instance paths, and six solid occurrences while preserving one unique box topology.
